acceptance_criteria.criterion: setItemsPerPageOptions stores sorted unique positive integers
hasItemsPerPageOptions returns false by default and true after configuration
resolveItemsPerPage returns effective value following priority chain: $_GET → GridSettings → default

Invalid $_GET[ipp] value (not in options) is ignored
getItemsPerPageURLTemplate contains {IPP} placeholder with no sentinel leakage
setItemsPerPageParam allows customizing the parameter name

summary: All 9 acceptance criteria verified via 14 new PHPUnit tests added to GridPaginationTest. setItemsPerPageOptions sorts/deduplicates/filters positive integers. hasItemsPerPageOptions is false by default. resolveItemsPerPage follows $_GET → GridSettings → default priority chain with lazy caching, auto-persists valid $_GET values, ignores invalid ones. getItemsPerPageURL resets page to 1 and injects the ipp parameter. getItemsPerPageURLTemplate replaces sentinel with {IPP} with no leakage. setItemsPerPageParam customises the GET key correctly. Full suite: 112/112 pass, PHPStan level 6: 0 errors.

comments.note: The Developer did not add PHPUnit tests for the 14 new IPP methods. QA added 14 tests covering all 9 acceptance criteria. All tests pass (112/112). PHPStan level 6: 0 errors.

No issues — GridPagination implementation is clean and consistent with the established PAGE_SENTINEL/getPageURLTemplate() pattern. resolveItemsPerPage correctly handles the lazy-cache, priority chain, and auto-persistence to GridSettings.

summary: Reviewed src/Grids/Pagination/GridPagination.php (11 new methods, IPP_SENTINEL constant) and tests/Pagination/GridPaginationTest.php (14 new tests). No blocking issues found.
setItemsPerPageOptions correctly applies array_filter → array_unique → sort in the right order; array_filter preserves keys but sort() reindexes, giving a clean 0-indexed result.

resolveItemsPerPage: $_GET is validated against the options whitelist before use — correct security pattern (whitelist-before-use). The int-cast before in_array means '20abc' casts to 20 and could match an option, but real-world impact is nil given whitelist enforcement.
getItemsPerPageURL correctly handles relative URLs via parse_url + parse_str + http_build_query. Silently drops scheme/host/fragment — appropriate for this project's relative-URL use case.

Tests are comprehensive: priority chain, persistence, caching, URL construction, custom parameter, and $_GET isolation via try/finally superglobal restoration. PHPStan level 6 passes (0 errors), 112/112 tests pass.

comments.note: resolveItemsPerPage: (int)cast before in_array whitelist check means '20abc' would cast to 20 and match option 20. filter_var($_GET[...], FILTER_VALIDATE_INT) would be more strictly correct, though the whitelist check makes the practical impact nil.

getItemsPerPageURL silently drops URL scheme, host, port, and fragment — only path+query are preserved. This is correct for the current relative-URL use case but would surprise callers using absolute URLs. A note in the PHPDoc would aid future maintainers.
No issues — Code is clean, idiomatic, and faithfully follows the established page-sentinel/URL-template pattern. PHPStan compliance and comprehensive test coverage confirmed.
